Comparing the header address field with the start address of the Mem driver binary (if the Mem driver was not compiled as a relocatable binary) 2. Unique ID validity 3. Availability and consistency of the delimiter field If any of these checks fails MemAcc_ActivateMem shall raise the development error MEMACC_E_MEM_INIT_FAILED .
